_about: Atlas's additions to rela's description: rules the current rela cannot hold, because it refuses unknown keys in schema.yaml. State merges this file into the description it answers, key by key; Control applies the rules for any kind. Data, not code: no BEAM module names a kind. Per kind: create.ask = the only fields a create form asks for; create.id = how the id is made: prefix plus the next free number, zero-padded to digits; or from a property (from), whose value must match pattern, with template filled from its groups ({1}, {2}, ...) after replace, and error when it does not match; the same value always makes the same id; nobody ever types or changes an id, nor the property it is made from; create.defaults = values for the fields create does not ask; properties.<name>.set_by = a field only a connector or the system fills (never in a form, shown only when it has a value); properties.<name>.multiline = true for text of several lines and sections (a form edits it in a multi-line editor; the line breaks are kept); properties.<name>.label = the name a page shows for the field instead of its own. progress = how far an item is, worked out from the items under it on every read, never stored, and shown in lists instead of its own field: over = the relation whose items point at it, field = the property that says how far such an item is (for a kind without a rule of its own), own = its own property, shown while nothing is under it. The top-level progress gives the order of the values (least far first; the least far child wins), done = the property that marks an item finished, done_label = what a list shows when every child is. primary = the property that names a fact in a list and on its page (when it is empty, the property the id is made from names it); connector = an outside system's connector fills this kind, read-only: system (which connector), address (the property that says where the outside thing is), fields (property: the outside system's field it is copied from), until (property: values; a fact with one of these values is read no more). Per type: types.<name>.format = "url" for values that are web addresses (rela has no such type); Control offers to open a fact's first such field in a browser. Agent records (UC-Atlas-19): agent = "request" or "step" names the kinds the agent keeps its requests and steps in (the agent never puts them as tools); start = {key, label} keeps a top kind off the start page and puts an action there that opens its list; order = "newest" lists a kind newest first; by_hand = false: no keys to make, change or delete one (the agent writes it); properties.<name>.cause = true or a title: an item page lists the facts of this kind whose field holds the item's key; relations.<name>.add = false: a page lists the facts of that relation without an action to add one.

id.error: url must be a GitHub pull request URL, e.g. https://github.com/eyra/atlas/pull/12
